coach.title: Look around
coach.text: The top of the table shows one opponent at a time. Tap Rook’s portrait, then Bryn, to see her side.
coach.desktop: Everyone sits across the top. Bryn, at 31 life, has a Colossal Dreadmaw. Rook is down to 3.
